versions.content: If one of the optional cluster-specific configuration parameters FRIF_E_NIT_CH_A, FRIF_E_NIT_CH_B, FRIF_E_SW_CH_A, FRIF_E_SW_CH_B or FRIF_E_ACS_CH_A, FRIF_E_ACS_CH_B exists, then call FrIf_GetChannelStatus for each FlexRay controller of the cluster and report the status to DEM as described be- low.
